integrity: An all-parameter elementary-collapse proof establishes the integral claim; finite checks of three parameter pairs are corroborative rather than an all-parameter certificate. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to ordinary three-cut complexes of Cartesian products of cycles with both lengths at least five; classifies integral homology of the cut complex and homotopy of its Alexander dual, not the homotopy type or equivariant homology of the cut complex itself.
title: Toroidal-grid three-cut complexes retain two adjacent integral homology degrees
